brand.name: Archava
brand.tagline: A real conversation. A face to remember.
brand.heroBody: One ready-to-use digital host. Speak naturally, ask about this website, and explore how a live AI host could help your business.
brand.businessDescription: Shape an AI host around your brand, approved knowledge, and customer journey. Hospitality, retail, education, and events are example use cases.

sections.label: Home
sections.description: Introduces the conversational host and the live conversation button.

sections.label: The avatar
sections.description: Shows concept portraits or the active live session. The portraits are illustrative; the live avatar comes from the configured provider.

sections.label: How it works
sections.description: Explains opening a conversation, allowing the microphone, and speaking with the AI host.

sections.label: For business
sections.description: Presents possible business integrations. This page does not submit inquiries or provision an integration.

overview.text: Archava is a conversational AI host. Ava is the host's name. The visitor is already in a live conversation. The host answers from this project's approved facts and can guide visitors to configured website sections.

experience.text: The visitor speaks by microphone. Gemini provides realtime conversation and LiveKit transports the call. The current session's provider and duration are given separately in trusted session context. Concept portraits on the website are illustrative.

business.text: A brand-specific host could help with hospitality, retail, education, events, and customer experience. These are example use cases, not provisioned integrations. Pricing, timelines, and delivery commitments have not been approved.

integration.text: This template has internal session endpoints for its website. It does not include a public customer SDK, customer API key dashboard, booking system, CRM, billing, or automated account provisioning.
